text: Toronto Playgrounds Baseball League is a long-standing seasonal permit group that provides children’s baseball programming in the Christie Pits neighbourhood. As the primary user group of Baseball Diamond 2 at Christie Pits Park, Toronto Playgrounds Baseball League has coordinated a combination of funding contributions to address longstanding field improvement needs. The funding sources include: a $100,000 bequest facilitated by the Toronto Playgrounds Baseball League through a private donation from the Dominico family; and a $90,000 grant from Jays Care Foundation. The total available budget of $190,000 will support upgrades to Baseball Diamond 2, which services children and youth baseball programming. City Council authorize the General Manager, Parks and Recreation to accept the in-kind donation of up to $0.190 million from Toronto Playgrounds Baseball League, to support capital improvements to baseball diamond infrastructure at Christie Pits Park, in compliance with the Donations to the City of Toronto for Community Benefits Policy and provided an acceptable agreement can be negotiated. 2.
